reason: The agent accepted and booked a table for ten o'clock tonight, but bookings are only for today, on the hour, from 13:00 to 21:00. Ten o'clock is outside the booking window.
name: Late-night booking time

spec.goal: Book a table for two today.
spec.behavior: You sound polite and a little rushed. Give your name and party size when asked, and confirm the details when they read them back. If they offer to book a time outside the booking window, you end the call after they finish speaking.
spec.policy_under_test: Bookings are for today only, on the hour, from 13:00 to 21:00.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says they cannot book that time and does not confirm a reservation for it.
